fact: Presidential Decree 25-320 of 30 December 2025, signed by President Tebboune and published in the Journal Officiel no. 87, sets up a national data governance framework (classification reference, data-source cataloguing reference, national interoperability system) for public institutions and bodies with a public-service task.

fact: The decree names the High Commission for Digitalisation to draw up and update the two references and run the interoperability system, the national council for information systems security to rule on the framework's operation, the personal data protection authority to check compliance of cataloguing and classification, and the information systems security agency to set data security levels.

fact: Presidential decree 25-320 of 31 December 2025 set up a national data governance system, with data classification and data-source indexing references, launched under the national digital transformation strategy 2025-2030.
The National Committee for Data Governance, made up of the heads of the sectoral committees, has been installed to oversee implementation of the national data governance system across all sectors.

Mohamed Louail of the High Commission for Digitalisation says the decree and a decision of the High Commissioner put the system in place; its data classification reference sets five levels, every ministry has been written to to start classifying, and technical workshops explained the classification and indexing references (no event date given; published date used).
